rent.name: RTB Average Monthly Rent Report via CSO (RIQ02)
rent.definition: Average monthly rent (EUR) for tenancies registered with the RTB in the quarter. Whole-property rent, not room rent.

methods.published: Published by the RTB for this area, size and type in the latest quarter.
methods.carried: The latest published figure from an earlier quarter (up to 2 years), adjusted by this area's rent growth since then (or Dublin's, if the area has no figure).
methods.estimated: Not published for this area. This area's all-homes average multiplied by how this size and type compares with the all-homes average across Dublin.

transit.name: National Transport Authority GTFS static timetables

groceries.name: OpenStreetMap contributors via Nominatim
groceries.note: May be incomplete: community-maintained map data.

bikes.name: OpenStreetMap contributors (Dublinbikes docks)
bikes.note: Docks mapped in OpenStreetMap; not every station may be included. See dublinbikes.ie for the live map.

employers.name: OpenStreetMap contributors via Nominatim
employers.note: Counts places that could employ students within about 1 km. Not vacancies. Counts stop at 40 per place type.
